setup: Setup (current figures): v4 data, 2010-2019, pipeline5 monthly IF zones (90th pct, SST z < -0.5, SSL z < 1.0, depth >= 10 m; outputs/redo/cache/zones/iforest.npz == figs/bayth_preclassified.pkl, 0/120 month-years differ) and the redo -1 sigma rule (redo/sigma.py). Daily pixels take the zone map of their own month-year.

sigma_share.note: sd uses ddof=1 here (pandas default, as in the old notebook); redo/sigma.py uses ddof=0, which changes the redo % by < 0.01 pp at ~40k pixels per map.
